issue_request: FHIR-41431 was an Applied FHIR-core Vocabulary change request for R6 to document the terminology-server parameter originally described as implySystem. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution named the parameter inferSystem, made it an optional boolean input on ValueSet $validate-code, limited it to the code input rather than coding or codeableConcept, and added text saying that if a code is provided either system or inferSystem SHOULD be provided.
initial_application: Git commit b164dc66088d2bd560695ca63742ba8400ed99d5, titled Applied FHIR-41431, updated source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml on 2023-07-13 to add the inferSystem input parameter and the requested description sentence. Later commits touched the same OperationDefinition for other ValueSet $validate-code parameters, but the inferSystem application remains present.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists valueset=ValueSet and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-validate-code, confirming build scope. Terminology Infrastructure minutes from 2023-06-26, 2023-07-06, and 2023-07-20 align with the Jira path from implySystem discussion to the final inferSystem code-only limitation and mark the issue done. A later 2025 Zulip discussion of inferSystem ambiguity led to FHIR-53532 in FHIR-cql, but it did not create a final FHIR-core reversal.
